proposals.problemSummary: Network transport interruption, connection drop, DNS resolution failure, or server queue overload (RULE_P2_ENVIRONMENT_OR_NETWORK).
proposals.recommendedAction: Verify network connectivity, proxy routing, and SUT host reachability. Rerun the test once infrastructure stabilizes. Do NOT modify test code or application code.
proposals.rationale: The failure is caused by transient network or infrastructure instability. Test code and application source code are correct and must not be altered.
